Mr. Ujjwal Phasate, App for the State.
Coram : Mrs. Vrushali V. Joshi, J.

Heard.
2. Issue notice to the non applicant, returnable on 18/09/2025.
3.
Learned APP waives service of notice for non- applicant State.
4. The applicant has apprehension of arrest in Crime No.334 of 2025 for the offence punishable under Sections 420,409,467,468,471 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
5. The applicant is the gram sevak.
The allegations are made against the applicant and the co-accused that they sold the government land to third person, on the basis of assessment made by the gram sevak.
The learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the assessment was made by the gram sevak for the tax purpose.
It cannot be considered for any sale deed.
This is for fiscal purpose.
Considering the Kavita 2/2 15-aba 657-25 role played by this applicant as a gram sevak, the case is made out to grant ad interim protection to the applicant.

Hence, following order:
i] It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant-Dharmendra Chindhuji Thakre,
in connection with Crime No.334 of 2025 for the offences punishable under Sections 420,409,467,468 and 471 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code registered with Police Station Kelwad, District Nagpur, the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rupees Twenty Five Thousand with one surety in the like amount.
